name: Icon Changer
tagline: Change app icons from a PNG, sized right
description: Pick an app, pick a PNG, and Icon Changer sizes the art to a centred 1024 canvas and applies it as the app's Finder icon. It backs up the original first, so one Revert button restores it. System apps that macOS protects are refused up front.
